# 03 — Analyze an uploaded reel into Video DNA

**What to build:** An owner can upload a short reel and receive a saved analysis report generated by the actual Video DNA and cohort-simulation workflow.

**Blocked by:** 02 — Run a deterministic cohort simulation.

**Status:** ready-for-agent

**UI-bearing:** Yes — reel upload and analysis-progress surface (`/analyze`).

- [ ] An authenticated owner can submit a supported reel of 30 seconds or less; invalid media and over-limit duration receive clear user-visible guidance.
- [ ] The upload is persisted securely, its audio is transcribed, its visuals are sampled once per second, and the pipeline produces validated Video DNA with hook, clarity, pacing, credibility, audience relevance, share trigger, and timestamped improvement opportunities.
- [ ] The saved Video DNA drives the same deterministic cohort simulation from ticket 02, creating a report tied to the owner and upload rather than a hard-coded demonstration outcome.
- [ ] The completed report includes exactly three prioritized timestamped recommendations with a suggested edit and its expected audience effect.
- [ ] Analysis progress, model/transcription failure, malformed analysis data, and access failures are communicated cleanly; external model calls are tested through their validated boundary rather than live vendor responses.
